STEP 1 - Vessel type: The food sits on a white plate with a raised rim band and a flat centre, with no inner wall or shadow. This is a flat plate, square in shape (corners visible).

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: square plates are 20-30 cm. The plate looks medium-large relative to the table and the food, so I estimate about 26 cm across.
b) Reference: the fork-sized objects are absent, but the plate spans roughly the width of the wooden table edge and the shoes at left. Using the sandal length (~25 cm) as a rough cue, the plate spans about one sandal length, giving ~24-26 cm. Reconciling, width ≈ 25 cm.

STEP 3 - Food items and footprints (square: width² = 625 cm²):
- Brussels sprouts (about 8-9 halves/whole sprouts, cooked): cover roughly 15% of the plate, about 95 cm². Thickness: one sprout (~3 cm) stacked about 1.5 deep, mound average ~1.5 cm. Volume ≈ 140 ml. Cooked vegetables at 0.6 g/ml ≈ 85 g.
- Rice/risotto with salmon (cream-coloured base with flakes of salmon and herbs, right side): covers about 20% of the plate, ~125 cm². Thickness: a mound about 2 cm peak, average ~1 cm. Volume ≈ 125 ml. Mash-like density 1.0 g/ml ≈ 125 g.
- Salmon fillet piece (right, one chunk): about 30 cm² footprint, thickness ~1.5 cm, volume ≈ 45 ml, density 1.0 → ~45 g.
- Green beans and sautéed mixed vegetables with shredded cabbage/carrot and a few pieces of white fish or tofu (bottom left): covers about 20% of the plate, ~125 cm², average thickness ~1 cm (flat-ish layer, mounded in places). Volume ≈ 110 ml; mixed cooked vegetables at 0.6 g/ml ≈ 70 g. Add the white cubed protein pieces (~20 g) separately.
- Greens garnish (arugula-like leaves at right edge, small): ~5 g cooked.

Hidden food: the rice base sits under the salmon, already counted. No additional hidden layer.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g (as served):
- Brussels sprouts, cooked with oil: ~60 kcal
- Rice with salmon and herbs: ~150 kcal
- Salmon, cooked: ~200 kcal
- Sautéed mixed vegetables with green beans and cabbage: ~70 kcal
- White fish/tofu pieces: ~120 kcal
- Greens garnish: ~25 kcal

Totals: roughly 470 g of food, about 650 kcal.
